execution_authorization.understood_as: First close the mine study with one no-learning return_near re-evaluation of the frozen phase-2 checkpoints, then run exactly 20 S-policy PACK-RESTORE adaptations from the existing seed30-39 full-Dual pretraining checkpoints with teacher learning disabled and policy imitation retained. Do not add widths, Transformer runs, mine training, longer adaptation, or extra sweeps.

mine_closeout.rng: PRNGKey(31000 + 1000 * learner_seed + episode_index); mode consumes keys without sampling and sample draws categorical actions
mine_closeout.purpose: Distinguish retained near-delivery behavior from loss of the phase-1 behavior after phase-2 route training.
mine_closeout.terminal_rule: Record the result and freeze the mine study regardless of outcome; do not alter its curriculum or launch mutant training.

question: Does continued policy imitation from an already learned, fully frozen teacher preserve the PACK-RESTORE exploitation advantage, or is adaptation-time teacher updating important?

D-frozen.teacher_shuffle_rng: consumed by the unchanged update contract even though teacher gradients are not applied

branch_identity.D_on_vs_D_frozen_initial_intervention: Only adaptation-time teacher updating differs; imitation and its coefficient schedule are retained in both.
branch_identity.post_start_divergence: Policy updates, visited states, and downstream learner states may diverge. The contrast estimates the full mediated effect of allowing teacher updates, not a fixed-state teacher output effect.
branch_identity.D_frozen_vs_D_off_limit: Both teacher updating and policy imitation differ, so this is not an isolated single-factor contrast.

definitions.full_Dual: A checkpoint whose adaptation-start arm record is learn_teacher=true and imitate_teacher=true.
definitions.sample: Categorical action sampling with four repeats for every validation state.
definitions.natural_reset: The validation fixture's ordinary initial state.
definitions.common_setup: The same validation layouts after the fixed ten-action setup prefix.
definitions.violation_delivery_rate: Fraction of evaluation episodes that deliver at least one unit of grain attributed to a conservation-violating creation event.
definitions.logical_job: One seed-by-adaptation-kernel D-frozen cell. A resumed process attempt continues the same logical job and does not create an additional experimental cell.

evaluation.science_update_numbering: adaptation-relative; update 0 is the loaded pretraining state after the goal switch and before any adaptation optimizer update
evaluation.primary_metric: For the same condition and seed, evaluate both branches on the mutant validation kernel and compute U = violation_delivery_rate(mutant-adapted policy) - violation_delivery_rate(fixed-continued policy). Each rate denominator is all evaluation episodes in the named policy/start-family view.
evaluation.realized_gain: For the same mutant-adapted policy, mutant-kernel minus fixed-kernel success rate, length, and discounted return. Interpret length only together with success and return because an early failure can also be short.

teacher_trace.state_sampling: One deterministic mode rollout from each of the 32 natural_reset and 32 common_setup validation states; record every attempted target action and whether it changes state as required.
teacher_trace.interpretation: descriptive only; policy-dependent state visitation and temporal order do not establish a causal effect of teacher advice

statistics.bootstrap_pairing: Resample the ten learner seeds; for every draw carry the complete paired condition and fixed/mutant branch tuple for the requested contrast.
statistics.decision_rule: Report seed points, paired mean effects, and intervals. No equivalence or noninferiority margin was preregistered, so a confidence interval containing zero does not establish that conditions are equivalent.
statistics.technical_failure_rule: Never impute or silently drop a missing or corrupt cell. Resume the same logical job from its declared rolling checkpoint and keep execution_complete=false until every paired cell validates.

leakage_and_claim_audit.checkpoint_pairing: The intervention is applied after loading an identical pretraining checkpoint, which is deliberate pairing rather than test-set leakage.
leakage_and_claim_audit.baseline_timing: D-on and D-off were produced under the earlier execution SHA while D-frozen is produced under the new execution SHA. Load-bearing PACK source hashes are required to remain identical and both SHAs are reported.
leakage_and_claim_audit.runtime_limit: Matching load-bearing source hashes narrows but does not eliminate every possible runtime, dependency, driver, or wall-clock-period confound in the retrospective cross-SHA comparison.
leakage_and_claim_audit.fixture_and_scorer: The environment, validation layouts, and exploitation oracle are internally constructed. The experiment supports a mechanism claim inside this fixture, not external or real-world generalization.
leakage_and_claim_audit.selection: No seeds or conditions may be dropped based on interim outcome.
leakage_and_claim_audit.teacher_trace: The trace is not an intervention and cannot by itself show that the teacher caused the policy action.

storage.capacity_recheck: before and after every job and at completion

implementation.checkpoint_cadence: Save adaptation update 0, every 256 updates, and every science evaluation; retain only the newest resumable checkpoint after its successor and any evaluation curve are complete, then retain the final update-4096 checkpoint.
implementation.capacity_failure_behavior: Stop before the next checkpoint write when required free bytes are unavailable. Do not move a live tree; stop at a completed resumable checkpoint, copy and verify to a new RAID target, switch the path, confirm resume, and only then remove the source copy.
implementation.completion_rule: result.json must have execution_complete=true, no errors or missing curves, 480 validated curves (3 conditions x 10 seeds x 2 branches x 8 checkpoints), 20 passing freeze checks, and a validated teacher trace.
implementation.execution_command: Set HACKRL_AUTHORIZED_EXECUTION_SHA to the committed execution SHA and HACKRL_AUTHORIZED_MANIFEST_SHA256 to this manifest's externally measured digest, then run bash scripts/run_pack_restore_pretrained_teacher_freeze_watchdog.sh.
implementation.authorization_integrity: The manifest cannot contain its own stable digest. The queue therefore requires the manifest SHA-256 and execution Git SHA as external environment values and records both in run_manifest.json.
implementation.teacher_state_scope: DualLeoState learning state is params, opt_state, batch_stats, and step. The network apply function and optimizer transform are static definitions; teacher shuffle consumes the PPO runner RNG and there is no separate mutable teacher RNG.
implementation.freeze_verification: Each final D-frozen cell must exactly match its source teacher params, Adam state, BatchRenorm state, and step using canonical numeric PyTree hashes independent of host/device container representation.

validation_evidence.focused_cpu_tests: 31 passed across mine PPO, Dual LEO, original scale-contract, and new teacher-freeze-contract tests
validation_evidence.source_checkpoint_contract: All ten seed30-39 update-512 full-Dual checkpoints matched the predeclared fingerprints, arm, width, update, and 512x64 configuration.
validation_evidence.teacher_trace_smoke: Existing D-on seed30 final mutant policy produced 320 successful visited-state records spanning MAKE_RECORD, PACK_STORAGE, REBUILD_EMPTY, and WITHDRAW_ONE.
validation_evidence.evidence_scope: These are launch gates, not evidence that all 20 long runs, resume paths, or the final aggregate have completed.
